_comment: CANDIDATE TEST FIXTURE, NOT A RELEASE VALUE. The r1007 genesis values as the chain's r1007 genesis notes record them before the r1007 consensus lanes are integrated (2026-11-09). The block-0 hash WILL change at integration, and the chain parameters marked pending owner there may change. Release values go only into release/network-cut.json, filled at the cut. Used by scripts/network-cut.test.mjs (the cut, applied to a copy of the repo with these values, must produce r1007-candidate.applied.json) and src-tauri/src/network_profile_tests.rs (the node config rendered from that profile must carry the [checkpoint] values the r1007 node requires).
